now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4#7
now.text: When the Spirit of Vengeance briefly passes to Mack, Robbie stops him from burning a Chinatown Crew member alive.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Saves Mack from a ghost, and stops him burning a Chinatown Crew member alive.
now.on_b_card_about_a: An agent who tracks Robbie, then briefly holds the Spirit of Vengeance.

proposed.text: When the Spirit of Vengeance passes to Mack, Robbie finds him at the Chinatown Crew hideout and strikes a new deal with the Spirit, freeing Mack and taking it back.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Saves Mack from a ghost, then frees him from the Spirit of Vengeance.

changes.evidence: Deals with Our Devils (AoS S4E7): Robbie calls on the possessed Mack to stop, but Mack throws the Chinatown Crew member Zhi into a wall and kills him. Robbie then makes a new deal with the Spirit of Vengeance, which leaves Mack's body and returns to Robbie. Robbie does not stop anyone being burned alive.

now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4#8
now.text: Director Jeffrey Mace leads the S.H.I.E.L.D. team that storms Eli Morrow's Chinatown Crew headquarters. He is reluctant to use Ghost Rider on the mission and insists that Robbie not be seen by the press.
now.on_a_card_about_b: S.H.I.E.L.D. director who storms Eli's Chinatown headquarters.
now.on_b_card_about_a: Darkhold villain whose headquarters Mace storms.

proposed.text: Director Jeffrey Mace joins the S.H.I.E.L.D. team that storms Eli Morrow's Chinatown Crew headquarters. He is reluctant to use Ghost Rider on the mission and insists that Robbie not be seen by the press.

changes.evidence: The Laws of Inferno Dynamics (AoS S4E8): Coulson and May propose the assault team, Mace decides to take part in it, and Coulson gives the order to launch the assault. Mace fights Morrow's men alongside May and Mack but does not lead the team.
